message.content:
You are applying curated review fixes to ONE Claude Code SKILL.md file in the Manifest repo (cwd = repo root).

Your work order is a JSON file (path below): an array with one {skill, path, fixes:[{category, severity, issue, proposed_fix, proposed_description?}]}.

CONTEXT DISCIPLINE: Read the order file once, Read the SKILL.md once, apply the fixes with Edit, verify, emit structured output. No other files, no greps. A prior agent may have partially applied fixes — if a fix's effect is already present, count it as skipped with reason "already applied".

HOW TO APPLY:
- fixes with proposed_description: replace ONLY the description value with the proposed text, verbatim, as ONE physical line. Double-quote the whole value if it contains ": " or starts with a YAML indicator char or backtick; escape embedded double quotes as \". Never touch the name: field.
- body / model-era fixes: implement proposed_fix faithfully. Keep the file under 500 lines. If a fix says extract to a sibling reference file, create <skilldir>/references/<apt-name>.md with the extracted content and leave a one-line markdown link in SKILL.md.
- NEVER delete security keywords, negative-space cross-references, quoted trigger phrases, or sub-agent model pins unless the fix explicitly replaces them.

VERIFY (one bash call): python3 -c "import yaml; yaml.safe_load(open('<path>').read().split('---')[1])" && wc -l <path>

Return JSON per the schema: which fixes applied vs skipped (short reason).

Work order file: /private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-chrismandich-emdash-worktrees-Manifest-emdash-big-squids-arrive-gnuik/6a5aa710-3321-4242-96d9-ef075e91fea5/scratchpad/order-single-skill-evolve.json

1	---
2	name: skill-evolve
3	description: Turn SkillClaw-evolved skills into a reviewed PR into .apm/skills/. Dry-run by default; --apply opens one PR with one commit per skill. Requires --enable-skillclaw and claude CLI login. Never writes source of truth directly — all changes go through PR review.
4	---
5	
6	# Evolve Skills (SkillClaw)
7	
8	Promote skills SkillClaw has evolved from your Claude Code session transcripts
9	into the committed `.apm/skills/` library — gated behind PR review.
10	
11	Backed by `~/.claude/scripts/skillclaw_promote.sh`, which ingests your recent
12	Claude Code transcripts (`~/.claude/projects/**/*.jsonl`), scrubs them of secrets,
13	evolves `SKILL.md` candidates via `"${EVOLVE_CLI}" -p`, classifies them
14	(NEW/CHANGED/UNCHANGED), drops any that fail frontmatter checks, and opens one
15	review PR per batch. No proxy, no daemon — transcripts are read passively.
